headline: Lawmakers criticize Nvidia's decision to re-appoint Jensen Huang as CEO
summary: A group of Washington lawmakers sharply criticised Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive. They said Congress should pass a law restricting US chip exports to China.
why: Nvidia is the leading maker of AI accelerator chips, and US export controls on advanced chips to China directly affect its sales.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Lawmakers' push for restrictions on chip exports to China could limit Nvidia's sales into that market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Legisladores critican decisión de Nvidia de volver a nombrar a Jensen Huang como CEO
